title: Workshop release-channel manifest
description: One document per channel (stable.json, alpha.json) on the `release-channel` branch of the release repo. Consumed by scripts/install.sh and by the in-app updater. Produced only by scripts/release/manifest.sh. Consumers must ignore unknown fields.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for breaking layout changes; consumers reject unknown major versions.

version.description: Semver of the release this channel currently points at (no leading v). Compared with the compiled-in version by the updater.

tag.description: Git tag of the release: v<version>.

release_repo.description: OWNER/NAME of the GitHub repo hosting the release (the WORKSHOP_RELEASE_REPO variable at publish time).

attested.description: True when GitHub artifact attestations (SLSA provenance, Sigstore-signed) were generated for the assets. Verify with `gh attestation verify <asset> --repo <release_repo>`.

previous_version.description: Version this channel pointed at before the current one (rollback target); null for the first release.

artifacts.description: Keyed by <os>-<arch> with os in {linux, macos, windows} and arch in {x86_64, aarch64}, matching the updater's detect_platform() label so it can index this map directly.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the archive (loopback http is accepted by consumers only for tests).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archive; identical to the SHA256SUMS entry.

binary.description: Path of the executable inside the archive (workshop, or workshop.exe on Windows).
